description: Works out a UK landlord's income tax on rental profit under Section 24, where mortgage interest is not deductible and is replaced by a 20% tax credit. Returns the tax bill, the 20% credit, cashflow after tax, the extra tax compared with full interest relief, and the same figures for all three tax bands.

annualOperatingCosts.description: Annual allowable costs excluding mortgage interest, in GBP.

annualRent.description: Gross annual rental income in GBP.

taxBand.description: The landlord's income tax band: basic (20%), higher (40%) or additional (45%).

name: calculate_section_24_tax
title: Calculate Section 24 tax
